verdicts.detail: judgment: key says 'The left hand limit is 3, the right hand limit is 4, so the limit of f at x = 1 does not exist.'; re-solver says 'Left limit 3, right limit 4; the limit at x = 1 does not exist because the one-sided limits differ.'
judgment: key says 'The limit does not exist.'; re-solver says 'The limit does not exist, since 3 is not equal to 4.'
